cards.answer: Bene, ma questo mese siamo pieni di scadenze.
cards.notes: How's work? / Good, but this month we're full of deadlines.

cards.answer: Due giorni alla settimana, gli altri in ufficio.
cards.notes: Do you work from home? / Two days a week, the rest in the office.

cards.answer: Simpatici, andiamo spesso a pranzo insieme.
cards.notes: What are your colleagues like? / Nice, we often have lunch together.
When are you going on holiday? / In August, like everyone.

cards.answer: Credo bene, mi richiameranno la settimana prossima.
cards.notes: How did the interview go? / I think well, they'll call me back next week.

cards.answer: Sì, domani niente treni. Prenderò la macchina.
cards.notes: Did you hear about the strike? / Yes, no trains tomorrow. I'll take the car.
Did you see the news? / No, what happened?

cards.prompt: Pare che aumentino i prezzi della benzina.
cards.notes: It seems petrol prices are going up. / Again? I don't believe it.

cards.prompt: Che lavoro faresti se potessi scegliere?
cards.notes: What job would you do if you could choose? / I'd be a tour guide.

cards.answer: No, è andato in pensione l'anno scorso.
cards.notes: Does your father still work? / No, he retired last year.

cards.answer: Sì, alle tre in sala grande.
cards.notes: See you at the meeting? / Yes, at three in the big room.

cards.answer: Sì, è stata una settimana pesante.
cards.notes: Are you tired? / Yes, it's been a heavy week.
